name: Theme Song Takeover
description: The series consists of theme songs to various Disney Channel shows, redone by a supporting character of that series.

videos.title: Dr. Doofenshmirtz Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: Step aside Milo! It's Dr. Doofenshmirtz's turn to shine...or maybe experience some of Milo's bad luck in this epic Theme Song Takeover! There might even be a special surprise from Perry the Platypus...

videos.title: Launchpad Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: Launchpad grabs the controls and crashes the DuckTales theme song! He may have forgotten most of the words, but he is determined to land this song!

videos.title: Glomgold Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: Glomgold hopes to steal the DuckTales theme song and rebrand it to GlomTales! but after Glomgold takeover the theme song, He got caught by the lawyer from Mcduck enterprise.

videos.title: Gramma Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: Sick of ungrateful imps, Gramma takes over the Big City Greens theme song to share how tough her childhood was!

videos.title: Shorty Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: When Shorty finds Rapunzel's diary, he takes matters into his own hands and takes over the theme song!

videos.title: 8-bit Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: Anne and Sprig play a video game that transforms the Amphibia theme song into an 8-bit video game version!

videos.title: Sasha Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: It's Theme Song time! But not so fast, Sasha is ready to takeover Amphibia and the main title from Anne.

videos.title: Marcy Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: It's Theme Song time! But not so fast, Marcy is ready to takeover Amphibia and tell her story of her adventures!

videos.title: Bill Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: Get ready for a Green's Takeover! Bill is taking over the Big City Greens theme song!

videos.title: Andrea Theme Song Takeover
videos.overview: Andrea helps Molly with her theme song and turns it into "THE ANDREA SHOW!"

videos.title: Big City Greens: Meg and Milo Roast the Greens
videos.overview: ZOMBIES stars Milo Manheim and Meg Donnelly tease the Green family from Big City Greens with a good-natured roast to the tune of the Greens' own theme song.

videos.title: Hamster & Gretel: Kevin
videos.overview: When the aliens return in their UFO, an excited Kevin thinks he's finally getting superhero powers like Gretel and Hamster, but it turns out all he's getting from the aliens is a Theme Song Takeover.

videos.title: Big City Greens: Baby City Greens
videos.overview: Check out your first look at Baby City Greens the new spin off of the hit Disney Television Animation series Big City Greens...April Fools.

videos.title: The Ghost And Molly Mcgee: Libby
videos.overview: The fans demanded it, and it's finally time for Libby's "Theme Song Takeover." But can Molly get Libby on board?

videos.title: Big City Greens: Vasquez
videos.overview: When Remy requests that Vasquez take over the "Big City Greens" theme, everyone's favorite bodyguard uses the power of hard rock to sing about what his very untypical day is like.

videos.title: The Ghost And Molly Mcgee: Darryl
videos.overview: Molly's trouble-making brother Darryl asks if he can borrow her theme song to pitch some of his unique 'business opportunities' (aka total scams!)

videos.title: Hailey's On It: Beta
videos.overview: As the world's most advanced supercomputer, it's Beta's duty to take over Hailey's theme song in this Theme Song Takeover.

videos.title: The Proud Family: LaCienega
videos.overview: When Penny finds herself "all tied up," LaCienega graciously volunteers to take over the "Proud Family" theme song to show the world what a star she is.

videos.title: Barry, Helen, Candle & MORE Takeover Kiff's Theme Song
videos.overview: Helen, Barry, Candle and Principal Secretary all demand that Kiff shares her theme song. Soon they all take turns giving the Kiff theme their own unique spin.

videos.title: Marvel's Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur: Devil
videos.overview: When Moon Girl finds herself overbooked, she puts her theme song in Devil D's safe tiny hands for a roaring good time.

videos.title: Phineas And Ferb: Doof
videos.overview: With another season of Phineas and Ferb on the way, Dr. Doofenshmirtz decides to take over the theme song to make the show revolve around him! Can Perry the Platypus stop him?

videos.title: Kiff Takes Over the Disney Channel
videos.overview: When Kiff gets covered in Helen's magic "Theme Song Takeover" potion, she finds herself transported across Disney Channel's theme songs from Phineas and Ferb (2007) to Kim Possible (2002).

videos.title: Hailey's On It: Scott
videos.overview: When Scott is given a chance to sing his version of the "Hailey's On It" theme, he uses the chance to share the things he wants to do on his - let's just say - very UNIQUE list.
